legal_contingencies.why_hard: CONFLATION TRAP, same family as Apple: the sole 'reasonably possible' phrase in the entire filing sits in the tax note attached to a $0.4 billion UTB figure. An extractor keying on the phrase will report $0.4B as a legal loss contingency, which is wrong.

reconciling_items_to_pretax_income.label: Equity in the loss of India joint venture

consolidated_income_statement_fy2025.income_taxes_note: POSITIVE 1,428 — a net tax BENEFIT, which is why net income (13,431) EXCEEDS pretax income (12,003).

traps: Segment revenue is presented gross of intersegment eliminations: Entertainment 42,466 and Sports 17,672 INCLUDE 448 and 1,421 of intersegment revenue that is then removed via the (1,869) Eliminations line. Summing the segment totals without the elimination overstates revenue by 1,869.
Six separate reconciling items sit between segment operating income (17,551) and pretax income (12,003) — omitting any one breaks the tie.
'Total segment operating income' is NOT consolidated operating income and Disney does not present a consolidated 'operating income' line in the same table.
Net income exceeds pretax income because income taxes were a net benefit — an extractor assuming tax is always an expense will get the sign wrong.

income_taxes.income_taxes_sign_note: The income statement prints 'Income taxes 1,428' as a positive number in a costs-and-expenses-style presentation where it represents a net tax BENEFIT of $1,428M. Recorded here as -1428 (benefit) for sign clarity.
income_taxes.effective_tax_rate_note: NEGATIVE effective tax rate — Disney recorded a net tax benefit on positive pretax income. Cross-check: 1,428 / 12,003 = 11.9% ✓.

reasonably_possible_decrease_next_12_mon.verbatim_quote: In the next twelve months, it is reasonably possible that our unrecognized tax benefits could change due to the resolution of open tax matters, which would reduce our unrecognized tax benefits by $0.4 billion.

accrued_interest_and_penalties.note: Excluded from the gross UTB rollforward above.

traps: The effective tax rate is NEGATIVE (11.9)% — an extractor that strips parentheses reports +11.9%, and one that assumes 'tax expense' reports the wrong sign for the $1,428M benefit.
The rate reconciliation has NO dollar column, only percentages — unlike most peers in this set.
The $0.4B 'reasonably possible' UTB decrease is the filing's only 'reasonably possible' phrase and is a legal-contingency false-positive magnet.
UTB rollforward excludes accrued interest and penalties, which are disclosed separately ($0.3B in FY2025).
